summary: Comprehensive mobile UI testing completed for 390px viewport. All mobile-specific features are working correctly: mobile navigation, stat card grids, form field stacking, autocomplete dropdowns, calendar horizontal scroll, and card-based layouts for Patients and Tasks pages.

integration_issues.issue: Emergent badge overlay intercepts pointer events on mobile nav buttons. Requires force=True or JavaScript click to work.
integration_issues.workaround: Use JavaScript click or force=True - navigation still works

context_for_next_testing_agent: Mobile UI is fully functional at 390px viewport. All features tested and passing.

mobile_navigation.details: Bottom tab bar renders correctly with 5 tabs (Home, Calendar, Patients, Tasks, Settings). All tabs are clickable and navigate correctly.

dashboard_stat_cards.details: 4 stat cards display in 2-column grid on mobile (grid-cols-2). Cards show: Today's Schedule, This Week, Pending Cases, Tasks Due.

quick_add_patient_form.details: Form fields stack vertically on mobile (grid-cols-1). All inputs have 44px height for touch targets.

diagnosis_autocomplete.details: Dropdown opens correctly on mobile, shows 15 options, items are selectable. z-index is high enough (9999).

cpt_code_autocomplete.details: Dropdown opens correctly on mobile, shows 74 options, items are selectable. z-index is high enough (9999).

calendar_stats_grid.details: 4 stats display in 2-column grid on mobile (Total Scheduled, Today's Cases, Conferences, Pending Add-Ons).

calendar_week_view_scroll.details: Week view is horizontally scrollable. Container width: 358px, Inner grid width: 600px (min-w-[600px]). Scroll works correctly.

calendar_view_toggle.details: Week/Month toggle buttons are visible and usable on mobile. Both views render correctly.

patients_mobile_cards.details: Mobile card section exists (md:hidden). Cards show patient info, status badge, diagnosis, procedure, attending, and prep progress.

tasks_mobile_cards.details: Mobile card section exists (md:hidden). Cards show task description, status badge, urgency badge, due date, assigned to, and patient info.

touch_targets.details: All touch targets meet 44px minimum: Mobile nav buttons (75x64px), Form inputs (44px height), Buttons (>=44x44px).
